messages.author: 2ea9cb5e12a1a254
messages.subject: Displaying Legend for Tip Labels
parts:
I have a tree on which I have plotted bootstrap values. I also display isolation source data by color-coding the tip labels, with the end goal of mapping data using ghetmap. The source data is input via a file with the following format:
Taxon Source Color
taxon_01 Location_01 Red
taxon_02 Location_02 Blue
taxon_03 Location_02 Blue
etc.
The Source dictates the color I assigned, so in this case they are essentially equivalent. This all seems to work fine with the following code:

intermediate_tree <- ggtree(tree_file, branch.length = T,ladderize = TRUE) + geom_tiplab(size = 3, linetype = "dashed", linesize = 0.1, align = TRUE, color = tip_colors$Color) + geom_nodepoint(aes(color=bootstrap), size = 2) + geom_nodepoint(shape = 1, size = 2, color = "black") + scale_color_gradient2(midpoint = 50, low = "navyblue",mid = "ivory", high = "red1")
gheatmap(intermediate_tree,matrix_file, offset = 0.3, width = 2, colnames = F) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey","black"))

I attach a version of the result below, for reference if helpful.

My difficulty is that I would like to add a legend for the tip labels identifying that Red tips are all from location 1, etc. My use of the theme() and theme_tree() functions only seem to be able to manipulate the bootstrap legend. I attempted to follow the advice given here (https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/76)  which got me errors of (Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (46): colour, node, parent, x, y), here (http://guangchuangyu.github.io/2014/12/viewing-and-annotating-phylogenetic-tree-with-ggtree/) and (https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/ggtree/inst/doc/treeAnnotation.html#the-operator) where the code:

ggtree(tree_file) %<+% tip_colors + geom_text(aes(color=tip_colors$Color, label=tip_colors$Taxon))
&
ggtree(tree_file) %<+% tip_colors + geom_tiplabt(aes(color=tip_colors$Color))  #or tip_colors$Source
returned:
Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (46): colour, label, x, y

When I strip out the bootstrap (and gheatmap) I still cannot find how to display the taxa label key.

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Displaying Legend for Tip Labels
parts:
see my reply in https://groups.google.com/forum/?utm_medium=email&utm_source=footer#!topic/bioc-ggtree/hViM6vRZF94

ggtree(tree_file) %<+% tip_colors + geom_tiplabt(aes(color=I(Color)))

should work.

NEVER use $ in aes
